title: The Sailfish Has a Sword on Its Face. It Never Stabs With It
subject: sailfish

scenes.text: A sailfish has a sword for a nose. It never stabs.
It slips the thin bill into a school of sardines so quietly that the fish barely react.
Then it slashes sideways. The bill tip can turn five hundred and seventy-five degrees in one second.
They hunt in teams. Up to forty sailfish have been seen circling a school, taking turns to attack.
Slashes injure the sardines. Gentle taps then pick off single fish.
So the sword isn't a spear. It's a whip.

description:
A sailfish has a sword on its face, but high-speed video shows it almost never stabs with it.
It slashes sideways to injure sardines, then taps single fish to finish them, often in teams of up to forty.
Would you have guessed the sword works like a whip?
first_comment: Would you rather meet a sailfish or a swordfish? Which one do you think is faster?
